en: Sum of angles = 180°. All three are equal.

q.en: Which of the following can be the sides of a triangle?

en: Triangle inequality: sum of any two sides > third side.
as: ত্ৰিভূজ অসমতা: যিকোনো দুটা বাহুৰ যোগফল তৃতীয় বাহুতকৈ ডাঙৰ হ'ব লাগে।

q.en: Two angles of a straight line are 3x and 6x. Find the value of x.

en: Angles on a straight line sum to 180°.

q.en: The complement of an angle of 35° is?

q.en: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 90°, 90° and 60°. Find the fourth angle.

en: Sum of angles of a quadrilateral = 360°.

q.en: Two lines intersect. One of the vertically opposite angles is 40°. Find the adjacent angle.
q.as: দুডাল ৰেখাই পৰস্পৰ কাটিছে। শীৰ্ষবিন্দু বিপৰীত কোণ এটা 40°। সন্নিহিত কোণটো নিৰ্ণয় কৰা।

en: Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.
as: সৰল ৰেখাত সন্নিহিত কোণ দুটা সম্পূৰক।
